title: Long-Haul Fuel Credit for Everyday Pay Card Holders, Cartwise Shopper Payouts
content:
# Cartwise Shopper Payouts field pay note: long-haul fuel credit

Shoppers on an Everyday Pay Card plan who drive long-distance batches receive a long-haul fuel credit with each statement payment. The credit is read from the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Batches: the batch pay entries booked with the long-distance pay component.

**Rule.** A long-haul fuel credit is added outside the cap. A shopper with 6 or more batch long-distance pay entries in the last month gets 3.00; one with 2 to 5 gets 1.50; and any other shopper gets nothing.

"The last month" counts the entries booked fewer than one whole month before the day of the payment.

## Input, judgement, output

| Long-distance pay entries in the last month | Judgement | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 6 or more | high band | 3.00 |
| 2 to 5 | low band | 1.50 |
| 0 or 1 | no band | none |

- Boundaries: 6 entries earn 3.00 and 5 earn 1.50; 2 entries earn 1.50 and 1 earns nothing.
- Only long-distance pay entries count; base-pay, tip and other entries on the same batches are not counted.
- The credit sits outside the monthly cashback cap and does not count toward whether a statement payment is owed.

## Illustration (hypothetical counts)

A shopper with 4 long-distance pay entries booked in the last month receives 1.50; an entry booked one whole month or more before the payment day is not counted.
